artworks.title: Baptismo habeo baptisari ...
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling with their eyes closed and arms crossed over their chest. The individual has delicate facial features with short, curly hair and wears a long robe. Various objects are scattered around, including a cross marked "INRI," ropes, a pitcher, a plate, and a crown of thorns. In the background, there is a textured design and a scroll with an inscription. The foreground contains tools and symbols related to penance and crucifixion.

artworks.title: S. Laurentius Martyr
artworks.description: The image depicts a man shown from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left, looking upwards with a serene expression on his face. His facial features include a prominent forehead, curved eyebrows, and a pronounced nose, with short, curly hair. He is wearing detailed, ornate clothing that resembles ecclesiastical robes, adorned with decorative patterns, particularly around the shoulder and neck area. The man holds a gridiron, a grid-like structure, with one arm wrapped around it, and he carries a palm frond in his hand. He is depicted with a halo. The background features a linear pattern.

artworks.title: Tuam ipsius animam ...
artworks.description: The image shows a person with a serene expression, hands clasped in front. The person wears a cloak with a hood, holding a sword in the left hand that extends diagonally upwards. There are rays emanating from the person, creating a halo effect, and a Latin inscription at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: S. Maria Magdalena
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up. She is turned to the side, with her head tilted forward and downward. Her facial features include closed eyes, arched eyebrows, and a serene expression. Her hair is gathered up at the back and some pieces frame her face. She wears flowing clothes with intricate details, and holds a book in her left hand and an ornate jar in her right hand. The background shows a landscape with crosses, trees, and a city or castle structure.

artworks.title: S. Virgo Virginum
artworks.description: The image features a woman facing forward with her head slightly tilted upwards. She has a serene expression, large eyes, and delicate lips. Her hair is partially covered by a veil, and she is wearing a robe with a cloak draped over her shoulders. Her hands are crossed over her chest. A halo of star-like shapes surrounds her head, and three other veiled figures are beside her, holding palm branches. The background has a textured, radiating pattern with no discernible setting.

artworks.title: Leda
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with figures and animals in a circular medallion. The scene features a reclining figure alongside a large swan, enclosed within swirling foliage and decorative elements like scrolls and animal figures. Above, there is an ornate canopy topped with a cherubic face or mask. The drawing showcases intricate ornamentation typical of Renaissance or Baroque decorative styles.

artworks.title: Diana
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with elaborate decorations. There is a central figure, possibly a deity, with a hunting dog, holding a crescent object and a spear. This figure is surrounded by an arching structure with floral patterns. On either side stand two symmetrical nude figures holding bows, with decorative shields nearby. Above them are stylized ram figures emerging from acanthus leaves. Above the central figure is a cherubic face surrounded by scrolls and foliage motifs. At the bottom are two smaller, semi-nude figures reaching upwards amidst swirling waves and ornate scrollwork. The composition is detailed and embellished with symmetrical ornamental designs including flora, twisted ropes, and abstract shapes.

artworks.title: Standing Soldier in a Long Cloak
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The individual's face is visible beneath the shadow of a hood, showing defined facial features with short, somewhat unkempt hair. They wear a heavy cloak with a hood over layered garments, fastened at the front. The attire includes long, vertically striped pants or a skirt, tucked into boots that extend above the ankle. The person holds a cylindrical object, possibly a staff or a tool, in their left hand. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the subject in the foreground.

artworks.title: Head of a Cleric
artworks.description: This image is a detailed drawing showing the profile of a man's upper body - specifically his head and shoulders. The man is positioned in a side profile, facing to the right. His facial features are distinctive, with a prominent chin and lips, a bulbous nose, and a well-defined jawline. He has short, curly hair, which is partially covered by a woven cap decorated with a pattern. His clothing includes a coat with a fur collar, and there is a cord near his neck with a decorative element or button. The background of the image has a textured pattern created by crosshatching. There is an inscription at the bottom left which reads "Bossi Sc. f. 1778."

artworks.title: Christ Arrives on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people walking together along a path in a natural setting. A figure with a shining outline around their head leads the group, with long hair and a beard. The other figures are also dressed in robes and cloaks. The background features dense foliage, an arched fence or wall, distant buildings, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Christ Praying on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a figure kneeling before an angel on a cloud. The artwork depicts a cloaked figure kneeling in a gesture of reverence or prayer. Above, on a cloud, an angelic being is depicted with wings, raising one hand as if gesturing towards the sky, and holding a chalice in the other hand. The background is filled with detailed foliage and trees. The scene is illuminated by beams of light from the heavens, highlighting the spiritual connection between the earthly figure and the angel. The line work and shading enhance the drawing's depth and form, emphasizing its mystical and contemplative theme.

artworks.title: Agony in the Garden
artworks.description: The image shows three figures resting at the base of a large tree. One figure is reclining with their head on their arm. Another figure is on their knees, leaning over a hill. Above them, an angel is soaring in the sky. Trees in the background suggest the horizon. The etching features detailed linework, creating textures in the clothing and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, with black and white tones emphasizing contrast.

artworks.title: Betrayal of Judas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene at night with dramatic lighting effects. There are figures in cloaks and robes, with one leading the group by pointing. Lush trees are around them, and a large flame to the left provides illumination. A cityscape is faintly visible behind them, and intricate details highlight the intense moment depicted. The drawing shows all characters and the background illuminated, adding emphasis to certain parts.

artworks.title: The Arrest of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a night scene. The image shows multiple figures gathering at night, some holding torches. The background features architectural elements resembling a town or city wall. Trees and swirling lines are visible in the sky. The drawing has intricate details and high contrast between dark and light areas. The figures are depicted in classical attire.

artworks.title: Christ before Annas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering of figures in a grand architectural setting. The scene shows individuals in robes in a hall or temple with columns and an elevated area. The figures are engaged in a dramatic moment, standing or gesturing around a central figure being led away. Symbolic elements like a torch, spears, and a circular emblem are included. The lines and shading emphasize the figures and architecture. The style resembles classical engravings or etchings, capturing seriousness and movement.

artworks.title: Peter Denying Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a fire inside what appears to be a room or enclosed space. The scene captures a group of individuals. The arrangement features detailed line work and cross-hatching to create shadow and depth. A fire burns in the foreground, providing light and a central focal point. Stairs ascend in the background, adding depth and perspective. The people are engaged in what looks like a discussion, with gesturing hands and attentive postures.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a meeting or council session. The central figure is seated in an elevated position amongst a gathering of individuals. The surrounding area is adorned with draped curtains and classical architectural elements like columns. The individuals are depicted in formal attire like robes or togas, suggesting an ancient setting. The use of shading and line work emphasizes clothing folds and architectural features. The scene conveys a sense of deliberation or an important discussion taking place.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a gathering of figures in a large, open room with a strong architectural structure. The scene includes numerous individuals, some seated and some standing, all dressed in robes. At the center, one figure appears illuminated with lines radiating around their head. Other figures around them exhibit various gestures. The setting includes steps, raised platforms, and archways.

artworks.title: Christ before Herod
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a large room filled with figures wearing robes. Some figures are seated while others are standing, engaging in what appears to be a discussion or event of importance. The architecture includes columns, draped fabric, and decorations like an urn on the wall. The figures seem focused on the proceedings, creating a sense of gravity in the scene. The detailed garments and room indicate precision in representing historical accuracy or significance.

artworks.title: Herod Sending Christ back to Pilate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals gathered in an architectural setting. The scene captures a group of figures on the stairs of a building, with others observing from a balcony above. The architectural elements are detailed with a focus on the vertical and horizontal lines of the structure. The figures are depicted in flowing garments and are interacting in a dynamic manner. Shadows and shading are utilized to convey the texture of the scene.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross between the Two Thieves
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with three crosses. The image depicts a dramatic scene of a crucifixion taking place on a hill with three crosses, surrounded by a crowd of onlookers. In the foreground, the figures are capturing movement and emotion, with some appearing to be gesturing toward the central cross. The background is filled with expressive cloud formations. The texture within the drawing is accentuated by intricate line work and cross-hatching techniques, rendering depth and contrast throughout the scene. The surrounding landscape and structures in the background suggest a historical or ancient setting.

artworks.title: The Virgin, Saint John, and Mary Magdalene at the Foot of the Cross
artworks.description: The image depicts a crucifixion scene with three figures on crosses, surrounded by groups of figures in robes. In the background, there are clouds and soldiers holding spears. The drawing is created using detailed line work to depict forms and textures.

artworks.title: Christ Dying on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts two figures on crosses surrounded by a gathering of people. Some figures are reaching up or pointing, while others appear to be kneeling or sitting with expressions of mourning or distress. The background features a landscape with hills and cloudy skies, rendered in a style that emphasizes line work and shading.

artworks.title: Descent into Limbo
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting multiple figures in a celestial setting. The central figure stands on a cloud with rays radiating around them, while surrounding figures gesture towards them. Some figures have wings. The drawing shows swirling clouds and strong lines to convey movement and depth in the scene.
